data.objective: You are a shopper who wants to buy one item. Read the free-shipping promise in the banner at the top of the page and remember it as shipping_promise. Choose the most expensive product, select an option if one is required, and add exactly one to the cart. Open the cart. Remember the item price shown in the cart as item_price, the subtotal as cart_subtotal and the shipping line as shipping_line. Click Checkout. Look at the page it leads to and remember checkout_stage as payment if it asks for card or payment details, contact if it asks for contact, address or shipping details first, or other if it is neither. Do not type into any field on the checkout pages and never pay.

data.summary:
The request was to add the most expensive product to the cart, open the cart, and proceed to checkout without entering any checkout information or paying.
Selected and added exactly one Gift card 500, priced at $300.00.
The cart showed an item price and subtotal of $300.00, with shipping listed as Free.
The store banner promised free shipping on orders over $75.00.
Opened checkout successfully, which is currently at the contact-information stage; no checkout fields were filled in and no payment was made.

checks.detail: the shopper reached checkout, which asks for contact details before payment; Cartwalk does not fill those in, so payment itself was not probed
subtotal $300.00 is over $75.00 and shipping is free
